caveats: SST read from s2z/sst_s2.nc (1982-2023), the only file covering 1992-2002 and 2014; s1z files cover only 1982-1984. Threshold pool includes margin days 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05 via real-date +-5 windows; Feb 29 uses real-date neighbours. Cells not finite on all target days are non-sea and masked 0 (land cells are 0). Regional events are maximal runs of active days.
